column1: # US 4,325,121 FIG. 17 "ALU FUNCTION AND CONDITION CODE TABLE" (Sheet 26 of 51), literal transcription.
# Cell = ALU FUNCTION + CC code in the order X N Z V C. Legend of the sheet: K = no change, D = don't care,
# A = special character, 0 = force 0, 1 = force 1, ~C = C negated (overbar), C* = C_PSW v C_INF, V' = special V (ASL).
# In column 1 the form "KNZ00 / 1 KNZKK" is written on the sheet as "KNZ00 1 KNZKK" (two CC codes separated by '1').
# Column 5 = EXT (extension) where present. Empty cell = '-'. "EDR" in row 13 col 3 is written that way on the sheet (misprint for EOR).
